title: The Hunter and the Horseman
summary: Across the rocky pastures and olive orchards of ancient Greece, a memorable encounter unfolded. Through unexpected trial and turning point, each character learns that do not squander your store upon strangers until your own needs are secured.
full_text: Across the rocky pastures and olive orchards of ancient Greece, a memorable encounter unfolded. A hunter caught a hare, but encountering a horseman who praised his prowess, gave the prize away in vanity, only to return home to an empty hearth..... The surrounding valley lay quiet in the midday heat, yet within the peaceful scene, natural instincts and rival interests were quietly at work. Before long, the initial quiet gave way to a sharp challenge as unexpected circumstances forced both sides to act. Natural instincts and sharp wits collided, bringing the trial to an immediate, decisive climax. Words of sharp wit and warning were spoken before the final consequence struck. Each party sought to press their advantage, weighing spoken words against unspoken motives. When the decisive moment arrived, neither boastful pretense nor hasty excuses could alter the outcome. The outcome revealed the enduring truth of human character. The experience left behind a timeless truth for all who heard the tale, demonstrating that do not squander your store upon strangers until your own needs are secured.
moral: Do not squander your store upon strangers until your own needs are secured.
